scan.policy: Last 1,000,000 blocks, complete factory event query; previous 14 pools plus up to 24 recent pools prioritising non-leaf assets. Daily rescan after active screens settle. Bounded coverage, not the whole chain.

previousEpochHypotheses.failureCondition: Reject at the ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations meet both entry thresholds, or if any eligible quote fails the configured route/size checks. Do not interpret passing the screen as acceptance or profit. Preserve the original control and require the seven-day/1,000-observation gate; unknown extra gas, infrastructure, and model invoice costs remain excluded from any full-profit claim.
previousEpochHypotheses.name: wPONS four-hop size-curve probe
previousEpochHypotheses.rationale: Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: this WETH → USDG → PONS → wPONS → WETH route could show size-dependent net quote behavior across its supplied exact sizes. SIZE_CURVE must quote every supplied exact size up to 0.005 WETH and select the greatest current after-gas net; it must not scale outputs. Enter only when the selected quote meets the 20 bps edge floor and covers the 15000 bps gas-safety requirement for two consecutive eligible observations. The supplied training data does not validate this forward hypothesis.

previousEpochHypotheses.failureCondition: Reject at the predeclared ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations satisfy both entry rules, or if the route cannot produce valid quotes for the required exact sizes. A passing screen is not acceptance or profit. Retain the original control and require the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate; unknown extra gas, infrastructure, and model invoice costs preclude a full-profit claim.
previousEpochHypotheses.name: wPONS-mediated four-hop size-curve probe
previousEpochHypotheses.rationale: Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: the WETH → wPONS → PONS → USDG → WETH route may have a size-dependent after-gas net that is not represented by the rejected prior route/size cells. Quote every supplied exact size up to 0.005 WETH and select the greatest current after-gas net; do not scale quote outputs. Entry requires the selected quote to meet the 20 bps edge floor and cover the configured 15000 bps gas-safety requirement for two consecutive eligible observations. Training blocks 96049192 and 96066325 are examples of the forward observations recorded in the prior trials; they do not validate this new route or cell.

previousEpochHypotheses.name: wPONS triangle exact-size probe at 0.02 WETH
previousEpochHypotheses.rationale: Measured facts: the verified graph includes WETH → wPONS → PONS → WETH, using the wPONS–PONS pool and two WETH-linked pools. Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: testing this route at the supplied 0.02 WETH size may reveal an after-gas edge at this exact size; no training quote in the supplied cohort is asserted for this cell. Entry requires the current quote to meet the 20 bps edge floor and cover the configured 15000 bps gas-safety requirement for two consecutive eligible observations. The configured improvement threshold is ignored for EXACT_EDGE.

selection.policy: At most the latest 80 unseen frames per six-hour decision; other frames remain in published sources and never become forward evidence for this decision. Available menu is a deterministic 128-cell subset, not a complete market search.
